description: Radxa ROCK 4D (Rockchip RK3576) dev board, on order. A board record: Atlas flashes it from maskrom (rockusb) with Rockchip's loader file and no vendor tool; running, it serves the identity contract (board-lite, gaia/device.toml), read-only. Written from rkdeveloptool, U-Boot and Radxa's docs; untested on this board.

storage_target_evidence: docs.radxa.com ROCK 4D: 16 MB SPI NOR for the boot firmware (factory-flashed), an eMMC/UFS module interface and a microSD slot.
Atlas writes the OS image to the eMMC module; the factory SPI NOR bootloader stays.
instructions: Power the ROCK 4D off and take out any microSD card.
Hold the Maskrom button, power the board on, then release the button.
Connect the board's USB OTG port to this computer.
The board appears in maskrom (RK3576). Atlas runs the loader's DDR init and usbplug, writes the image to the eMMC, reads it back and restarts the board.
todo: The maskrom PID: 2207:350e for RK3576 is in no text source (rkdeveloptool's table stops before it; Gaia found none either), so it's marked pid_unconfirmed: a Rockchip in maskrom whose PID no record names and no chip claims is offered as this board, and its loader must report chip RK3576 before anything is written (a chip it can't read stops the flash too). Confirm with lsusb on the board and drop pid_unconfirmed.

The rkbin parts are in fetch.lock (not in git): rkbin 3e288fe's RK3576MINIALL.ini is a three-part loader (rk3576_boost_v1.03, rk3576_ddr_lp4_2112MHz_lp5_2736MHz_v1.13, rk3576_spl_v1.09, with rk3576_usbplug_v1.04 in maskrom) that boot_merger merges into rk3576_loader_v1.13.109.bin. rkbin doesn't publish the merged file; Gaia's build is its source.

The loader file: rk3576_loader_v1.13.109.bin (rkbin 3e288fe; idblock rk3576_idblock_v1.13.109.img), which Gaia's ROCK 4D build (006284a) copies next to sdcard.img. Atlas reads it: chip 3576, a 4 KiB FlashHead (RKNS) whose table lays out FlashBoost, FlashData and FlashBoot; the idblock Atlas builds follows it. Gaia's sdcard.img carries its own idblock (RKNS, unscrambled) at sector 64. Radxa ships it as rk3576_spl_loader_v*.bin; both names match.
The maskrom steps: taken from the ROCK 4AB SE guide (same button, a different board); the 4D's own page didn't load.
eMMC vs UFS: which module the board gets, and the usbplug's storage id for UFS (not in rkdeveloptool's cs list).
Writing the SPI NOR bootloader (rkdeveloptool wl 0 spi.img after cs 9) when the factory one must be replaced: not wired into Atlas's flash yet.
